name: baseline start-up and regulation
criterion: RUN without fault; |v2 - 400| < 4 V for t > 70 ms

name: V2 sensor gain +5 % (AMC1301 chain)
criterion: no trip (undetectable by design); true v2 = 400/1.05 within 1 %; true v2 <= 480 V

name: V2 sensor gain -20 % at 60 ms (AMC1301 chain, common cause for FW + HW OV)
criterion: true v2 must stay <= 480 V (LIM_V2_OV) or a trip must occur

name: V2 sensor offset -30 V at 60 ms
criterion: true v2 <= 480 V or trip; report true v2

name: V2 sensor fail-low (reads 0 V) at 60 ms in RUN
criterion: FAULT = V2_UV within 2 periods of the fault, gates off

name: V1 sensor fail-high (reads 1000 V = full scale) at 60 ms
criterion: FAULT = V1_OV within 2 periods; HW OV comparator also trips (same signal)

name: real HV bus over-voltage: V1 source ramps 800 -> 960 V from 60 ms at 40 V/ms
criterion: firmware FAULT V1_OV within 1 period of v1 > 900 V and before the HW comparator (920 V) is needed

name: LV load short (0.1 Ohm) at 60 ms
criterion: a trip occurs within 20 periods of the short; i_pk stays below the 32 A hardware limit (phi_max / EPS limiting); gates off

name: communication loss (heartbeat) at 60 ms
criterion: FAULT = COMM within 1 period, gates off

name: isolated-amplifier saturation: V2 chain clips at 500 V while an external source pulls the LV link to 520 V
criterion: FAULT V2_OV (clip level 500 V is above LIM_V2_OV 480 V: 4 % margin)

name: current-sense saturation: CT/ADC clips at 40 A FS during a load short
criterion: trip still occurs (40 A FS > 32 A trip): report clipped reading

name: ADC quantisation (12 bit) + noise 2 LSB rms on all channels
criterion: no fault in 100 ms; v2 std < 1 %, |mean - 400| < 1 % (t > 70 ms)

name: ADC noise 1 % of full scale rms (41 LSB) on all channels
criterion: no false trip at the nominal point; v2 deviation < 2 %

name: HV bus dip to 580 V (below LIM_V1_UV = 600 V) for 20 ms in RUN
criterion: FAULT = V1_UV (documented behaviour: UV is a fault in RUN)

name: HV bus dip 10 % (720 V) for 20 ms in RUN
enable removed during RUN at 60 ms
criterion: state INIT within 1 period, gates off, phi = 0

name: precharge feedback never true
criterion: gates never enabled for the whole run (Python reference stays in PRECHARGE_WAIT; the C core would FAULT after 5 s - discrepancy documented in Reliability_Engineering)

name: heatsink NTC reads 110 C at 60 ms (sensor short or real over-temperature)
i_pk sensor stuck low (CT open, reads 0) during a load short at 60 ms
criterion: documents the single-point CT: no I_PK trip expected; pass only if some trip occurs or i_pk stays < 40 A
